name: DGLD Tokenized Gold
oneLiner: DGLD is Gold Token SA's tokenized physical gold from Swiss vaults, each token redeemable for 1 troy ounce of allocated LBMA PAMP-refined gold.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery PAMP® gold bars allocated in insured Swiss vaults operated by MKS PAMP SA (1 DGLD = 1 troy ounce)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for physical PAMP® gold through Gold Token SA; minimum 1 gram, no custody or transfer fees

proofOfReserves.provider: Gold Token SA live bar registry (issuer-maintained; reconciles per-chain token supply to named PAMP bar serials with zero gap, verified via the registry API 2026-08-08; MKS PAMP is custodian/refiner, not an attestor, and no third-party audit is published - the litepaper's 'independent audit framework' has no artefact)

params.label: Allocated LBMA Good Delivery PAMP gold (Swiss vaults)

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: DGLD is a direct allocated-commodity claim: the June 2026 General Terms & Conditions make each token proof of Swiss-law co-ownership of allocated LBMA gold with title remaining with tokenholders, require segregated vault custody in Gold Token SA's name on behalf of tokenholders with MKS PAMP SA named as Custodian, and document physical Delivery with KYC. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14.

sources.label: DGLD General Terms & Conditions, last updated June 2026 (direct legal co-ownership of allocated LBMA gold, physical Delivery)
